acceptance: Native Rust, browser-grade WASM and TypeScript produce identical pack bytes, SHA-256 digests and summaries for seeds 1 and 42 at 0, 1, 2, 100, 1000 and 10000 nodes; empty, truncated, trailing-byte and bad-magic inputs fail with identical codes; pinned digests match.

negative.fixture: empty, truncated, trailing, bad magic, every bit flip never panics
negative.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-observation -p vsf-fixtures -p vsf-wasm -p vsf-native

versions.schema: VSFS pack v1 and wasm ABI 2 introduced

security_and_source_permissions: Only user-authorized origins are observed; form values and secret-shaped text never leave the page; no source application server is contacted; bridge and extension commands are origin- and sender-checked.
performance_memory_storage: WASM analyze 0.5 ms at 1k nodes, 4.96 ms at 10k (native 0.32 / 3.70)
known_limitations: Pack format and WASM ABI 2 are v1 prototypes; compatibility rules arrive in B02
